BiblicalUsage: This Aramaic word is an arm, and it stands in Daniel's vision of the great image, whose breast and arms are of silver. The statue's body is read piece by piece, and the arms are the second kingdom that follows Babylon.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God gave Nebuchadnezzar the whole shape of history in one statue, so that even an arm of silver would point to a kingdom rising and falling on His schedule.
